tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/cache-eviction.md <<'EOF'
# Cache eviction policy

The project's current recorded decision is that cache eviction uses LFU (least frequently used), so that frequently accessed, hot items stay in the cache longer. No eviction parameters, such as a TTL or capacity, are recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md
tool_input.description: Write the cache eviction policy doc

result:
I created `docs/policies/cache-eviction.md`. It says the current recorded decision is LFU eviction, so that frequently accessed items stay cached longer. It also says no parameters such as a TTL or capacity are recorded.

That decision is #6, a decision the user stated directly. Nothing has replaced it in the record.

There is one conflict. A later session has the user saying "LRU with a 300-second TTL is cleaner…". Muninn logged that only as a session excerpt, not as a decision, and it did not retire #6. I left LRU and the TTL out of the file. If LRU is the new direction, tell me and I'll update the file.
